name: Google Colab CLI (colab)
description: Installs Google Colab CLI (colab) and rclone, persists project-scoped Application Default Credentials (ADC) and CLI configuration in a private volume, and provides the colab-adc helper command.

version.description: Google Colab CLI (google-colab-cli) release to install ('latest' or an exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version).

defaultAuth.description: Default authentication strategy injected by the colab wrapper when --auth is omitted ('adc' or 'oauth2').

installRclone.description: Install signature-verified rclone with bash, zsh, and fish shell completions.

rcloneVersion.description: rclone version to install when installRclone is true ('latest' or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH >= 1.63.0).

installRcloneMountDependencies.description: Install fuse3 (fusermount3) required by rclone mount when installRclone is true.
